title: A corpus-based genre and collocational study of the near-synonyms: grasp, capture, seize, snatch, and take
core_idea: The study examines genre-specific, collocational, and semantic preferences of five near-synonymous English verbs (grasp, capture, seize, snatch, take) using the Corpus of Contemporary American English (COCA) and three traditional dictionaries, analyzing noun and adverb collocates and grouping them into semantic themes to characterize contextual usage.
tldr: A corpus-based analysis of how five near-synonym verbs pattern across genres and collocations, aiming to map their semantic preferences and inform genre-sensitive pedagogical tasks for ESL/EFL learners.
